assignments.node_id: שמאמין בה, שהקדוש־ברוך־הוא טוב לכל – הן לרפואה, הן לפרנסה, הן לכל הדברים
assignments.node_text: שֶׁמַּאֲמִין בַּה', שֶׁהַקָּדוֹשׁ־בָּרוּךְ־הוּא טוֹב לַכֹּל – הֵן לִרְפוּאָה, הֵן לְפַרְנָסָה, הֵן לְכָל הַדְּבָרִים
connected_to: בודאי יהיה עקר השתדלותו בתר קדשא־בריך־הוא, ולא ירדף אחר תחבולות רבות
assignments.reason: This node expresses complete faith in God's goodness — the Rebbe explicitly equates 'טוב ה' לכל' with תפלה (prayer). Believing that God is good for everything IS the essence of prayer: directing all effort toward God rather than human stratagems. Its essential nature is emunah/tefillah — trust in God that manifests as prayer.

assignments.node_id: בודאי יהיה עקר השתדלותו בתר קדשא־בריך־הוא, ולא ירדף אחר תחבולות רבות
assignments.node_text: בְּוַדַּאי יִהְיֶה עִקַּר הִשְׁתַּדְּלוּתוֹ בָּתַר קֻדְשָׁא־בְּרִיךְ־הוּא, וְלֹא יִרְדֹּף אַחַר תַּחְבּוּלוֹת רַבּוֹת
connected_to: שמאמין בה, שהקדוש־ברוך־הוא טוב לכל – הן לרפואה, הן לפרנסה, הן לכל הדברים
assignments.reason: Directing all effort toward God and not pursuing human stratagems is the practical expression of prayer/faith — the outcome of believing 'God is good to all'. Its essential nature is wholehearted devotion to divine service (עבודה תמה), which is the core of Package 4.

assignments.node_id: כשמביא הארה וברכה לתוך תחלת המחשבה
assignments.node_text: כְּשֶׁמֵּבִיא הֶאָרָה וּבְרָכָה לְתוֹךְ תְּחִלַּת הַמַּחֲשָׁבָה
connected_to: כשממשיך נשמה לבנו, בודאי הוא ממשיך נשמה בהירה וזכה
assignments.reason: Bringing illumination and blessing into the root of thought (תחלת המחשבה) is the mechanism of הארת הכבוד — illuminating the soul-roots. Its essential nature is הארה (illumination), the core concept of Package 1. The Rebbe explains this as the Torah scholar illuminating through his Torah study the root of souls in divine thought.

connected_to: כשמביא הארה וברכה לתוך תחלת המחשבה
assignments.reason: The son being a talmid chacham is the result of drawing a bright soul through the zivug of soul-sparking in thought. Its essential nature is the fruit of the soul-illumination process — a bright neshamah that has been drawn down. This belongs to the Kavod/illumination domain (Package 1), where zivug and soul-drawing already reside.

Torat Chesed is defined by the Rebbe as 'learning Torah in order to teach it' — the outward-radiating Torah that brings people to teshuvah and thereby elevates Kavod. Its essential nature is the instrument of Kavod's illumination: 'אין כבוד אלא תורה' and the Rebbe explicitly states that through Torat Chesed one elevates the Kavod. It is Torah-as-Kavod's-vehicle, placing it in the Kavod domain.

Converts and baalei teshuvah are the very definition of Kavod's elevation in this Torah — 'when people from outside holiness come close, THIS is His glory'. Their essential nature is the manifestation of Kavod rising. The package already contains 'להחזיר בני אדם בתשובה' and 'אם תוציא יקר מזולל' which are the same domain.
Same essential nature as 'גרים ובעלי־תשובה' above — making converts and baalei teshuvah is the essence of Kavod's elevation. This is a variant phrasing of the same concept.

The drawing-close of converts/baalei teshuvah is what the Rebbe defines AS Kavod's elevation itself — 'התעלות כבודו על ידי התקרבות הגרים או בעלי תשובה'. Its essential nature is the manifestation of divine glory.

Breaking one's pride is the precondition for Kavod's elevation — the Rebbe equates Har Tabor (הר = greatness, תבור = breaking) with this concept. Its essential nature is the humility mechanism that enables Kavod to rise. The additions file already assigned 'הר תבור / שבירת הגדלות' to Package 1 for the same reason — breaking pride IS the Kavod-elevation domain in this Torah.

The elevation of Kavod is a direct expression of the Kavod domain — it IS כבוד in its dynamic aspect (rising to its root). Package 1 already contains 'החזרת הכבוד לשרשו' and 'הארת הכבוד'; this is the same essential nature.

Anavah (humility) is the enabling quality for Kavod in this Torah — 'ולפני כבוד ענוה'. The Rebbe explicitly states: one cannot attain holy Kavod except through humility. While humility causes Torah which causes Kavod, its essential nature in THIS Torah is as the gateway to Kavod: it is the inversion of pride that defines the Kavod-elevation pathway. Package 1 already contains the pride-breaking mechanism (via additions); anavah is the positive face of that same quality.

connected_to: לקרב את הגרים עם בעלי התשובה
assignments.reason: In this Torah, Torah is not a standalone domain — it is defined exclusively as the instrument of Kavod. The Rebbe says 'אין כבוד אלא תורה' and 'כבודו נתעלה על ידי התורה'. Torah here IS the vehicle through which Kavod shines outward (תורת חסד = learning to teach = bringing people close = Kavod's elevation). Its essential nature in Torah 14 is inseparable from the Kavod domain.
His glory being elevated is a direct expression of the Kavod domain — the dynamic state of כבוד rising. Same essential nature as כבוד, הארת הכבוד, and החזרת הכבוד לשרשו already in Package 1.

assignments.node_id: כל אחד לפי בחינתו יכול לידע העלאת הכבוד לשרש היראה
assignments.node_text: וְכָל אֶחָד לְפִי בְּחִינָתוֹ יָכוֹל לֵידַע הַעֲלָאַת הַכָּבוֹד לְשֹׁרֶשׁ הַיִּרְאָה
assignments.reason: This node describes the knowledge of Kavod's ascent to Yirah — its essential nature is the awareness/measure of Kavod's elevation. It is about Kavod's return to its root, which is the core dynamic of Package 1.

assignments.node_id: כשממשיך נשמה לבנו, בודאי הוא ממשיך נשמה בהירה וזכה
assignments.node_text: כְּשֶׁמַּמְשִׁיךְ נְשָׁמָה לִבְנוֹ, בְּוַדַּאי הוּא מַמְשִׁיךְ נְשָׁמָה בְּהִירָה וְזַכָּה
connected_to: כשמביא הארה וברכה לתוך תחלת המחשבה
assignments.reason: Drawing a bright, pure soul to one's son is the result of the soul-sparking (זיווג/התנוצצות) process already in Package 1. Its essential nature is the transmission of luminous neshamot — the same domain as the zivug and פרסה שלמה concepts (additions) within the Kavod/illumination cluster.

assignments.node_id: תורה שמאירין להם אל מקום שהם שם
assignments.node_text: הַתּוֹרָה שֶׁמְּאִירִין לָהֶם אֶל מָקוֹם שֶׁהֵם שָׁם
connected_to: לבוא להתעוררות התשובה – הן לרשעי ישראל, הן לגרים
assignments.reason: Torah that illuminates outward to where they are ('יפוצו מעינותיך חוצה') is Torat Chesed in action — the outward-radiating illumination that IS Kavod's mechanism. Its essential nature is הארה (illumination spreading outward), the defining quality of Package 1.

assignments.node_id: לבוא להתעוררות התשובה – הן לרשעי ישראל, הן לגרים
assignments.node_text: לָבוֹא לְהִתְעוֹרְרוּת הַתְּשׁוּבָה – הֵן לְרִשְׁעֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל, הֵן לַגֵּרִים
connected_to: תורה שמאירין להם אל מקום שהם שם
assignments.reason: The awakening to teshuvah of sinners and converts is the manifestation of Kavod's elevation — identical in essence to 'להחזיר בני אדם בתשובה' already in Package 1. The Rebbe defines bringing people to teshuvah AS the definition of Kavod's glory (אם תוציא יקר מזולל).
Elevating the Kavod is a direct expression of the Kavod domain — synonymous with 'העלאת הכבוד' and 'החזרת הכבוד לשרשו' already in Package 1.
Holy Kavod (כבוד דקדושה) is explicitly the good-polarity Kavod of this Torah. Its essential nature IS כבוד — the core concept of Package 1.

assignments.node_id: לקרב את הגרים עם בעלי התשובה
assignments.node_text: לְקָרֵב אֶת הַגֵּרִים עִם בַּעֲלֵי הַתְּשׁוּבָה
assignments.reason: Bringing converts and baalei teshuvah close is the defining act of Kavod's elevation in this Torah. Same essential nature as 'להחזיר בני אדם בתשובה' and 'אם תוציא יקר מזולל' already in Package 1.

connected_to: לתקן הסתלקות הכבוד, שנפגם על־ידי הסתלקות הצדיק הזה, שהיה מצדיק את הרבים
assignments.reason: Hesped (eulogy) is defined by the Rebbe as repairing the departure of Kavod — 'הספדא יקרא דחיי או יקרא דשכבי'. Its essential nature in this Torah is as a mechanism for restoring Kavod when it is damaged by the loss of a tzaddik. It is a Kavod-repair tool.

assignments.node_id: לתקן הסתלקות הכבוד, שנפגם על־ידי הסתלקות הצדיק הזה, שהיה מצדיק את הרבים
assignments.node_text: לְתַקֵּן הִסְתַּלְּקוּת הַכָּבוֹד, שֶׁנִּפְגַּם עַל־יְדֵי הִסְתַּלְּקוּת הַצַּדִּיק הַזֶּה, שֶׁהָיָה מַצְדִּיק אֶת הָרַבִּים
assignments.reason: Repairing the departure of Kavod caused by the death of a tzaddik who was mazdikey harabim — this is explicitly about Kavod's damage and restoration. Its essential nature is the Kavod domain: the blemish in divine glory that needs repair.

The measure of one's rectification of Kavod (תיקון הכבוד) is explicitly a Kavod concept — it measures how much one has restored divine glory. Same domain as כבוד, החזרת הכבוד לשרשו, and מכבד יראי השם (all in Package 1).

assignments.package_label_en: Fear of God — Root of Glory
assignments.reason: The completion/repair of the blemishes in Yirah (fear of God) is essentially about Yirah itself — its restoration to wholeness. Its essential nature is Yirah, the root to which Kavod returns. This belongs to Package 2 (Yirah), not Package 1 (Kavod), because the concept described is the state of Yirah being made complete.

connected_to: נתבטלים כל המניעות והמסכים המבדילים בינם לבין הקדשה
assignments.reason: Stripping off the soiled garments refers to the process of teshuvah — removing the impurities that prevent sinners/converts from returning to holiness. In this Torah, teshuvah IS Kavod's elevation ('אם תוציא יקר מזולל'). The soiled garments are the barriers to Kavod's restoration, making this part of the Kavod-elevation domain.

assignments.node_id: נתבטלים כל המניעות והמסכים המבדילים בינם לבין הקדשה
assignments.node_text: נִתְבַּטְּלִים כָּל הַמְּנִיעוֹת וְהַמָּסַכִים הַמַּבְדִּילִים בֵּינָם לְבֵין הַקְּדֻשָּׁה
assignments.reason: The removal of all barriers and screens separating people from holiness is the clearing of the path for Kavod's return. Its essential nature is the removal of obstacles to teshuvah/conversion, which IS the Kavod-elevation process in this Torah.

Healing/refuah is essentially the restoration of shalom within the body — when the elements are in harmony (במזג השוה). The Rebbe explicitly states: 'עקר הרפואה על ידי השלום' and 'שלום שלום לרחוק ולקרוב אמר ה' ורפאתיו'. Refuah is the physical manifestation of Shalom — wholeness of the body's elements. Its essential nature is bodily peace/harmony, placing it in Package 3.

assignments.node_id: צריך להעלות כבוד הקדוש־ברוך־הוא לשרשו, הינו ליראה
assignments.node_text: צָרִיךְ לְהַעֲלוֹת כְּבוֹד הַקָּדוֹשׁ־בָּרוּךְ־הוּא לְשָׁרְשׁוֹ, הַיְנוּ לַיִּרְאָה
assignments.reason: This is the Torah's opening thesis statement — elevating God's Kavod to its root in Yirah. Its essential nature is the Kavod-elevation imperative, identical to 'החזרת הכבוד לשרשו' already in Package 1.

assignments.node_text: הַכָּבוֹד שֶׁמְּכַבֵּד יִרְאֵי־הַשֵּׁם, שֶׁהוּא בְּחִינַת הַחֲזָרַת הַכָּבוֹד לְשָׁרְשׁוֹ, דְּהַיְנוּ לַיִּרְאָה
assignments.reason: The honor one gives to God-fearers, which is the return of Kavod to its root in Yirah — this is a variant phrasing of 'מכבד יראי השם' and 'החזרת הכבוד לשרשו', both already in Package 1. Its essential nature is Kavod operating through honoring the God-fearing.

Universal peace (shalom haklali) is the fullest expression of Shalom — peace across all worlds. Its essential nature is שלום in its cosmic/universal dimension. Package 3 already contains שלום; this is its ultimate form.

assignments.node_text: זוֹכֶה לַשָּׁלוֹם הַכְּלָלִי, הַיְנוּ שְׁלֵמוּת הָעוֹלָמוֹת
assignments.reason: Universal peace as the completion of all worlds — the Rebbe defines this as 'שלמות העולמות'. Prayer is called 'קרבן' (sacrifice) because it means 'קירוב העולמות לשלמותן' (bringing the worlds to their completeness). This is Shalom in its most expansive form. Essential nature is שלום/שלמות.

Shiflut (lowliness/self-diminishment) is the essential prerequisite for Torah which in turn elevates Kavod. The Rebbe devotes Section ה to explaining the four levels of shiflut and equates Har Tabor (already assigned to Package 1 in additions) with שבירת הגדלות. Shiflut/anavah are the same quality in this Torah — the gateway to Kavod's elevation through humility.

assignments.node_id: "יקרא אל השמים מעל" – זה הנשמה, "ואל הארץ" – זה הגוף (סנהדרין צא:). וכשיש ביניהם שלום
assignments.node_text: "יִקְרָא אֶל הַשָּׁמַיִם מֵעָל" – זֶה הַנְּשָׁמָה, "וְאֶל הָאָרֶץ" – זֶה הַגּוּף (סַנְהֶדְרִין צא:). וּכְשֶׁיֵּשׁ בֵּינֵיהֶם שָׁלוֹם
assignments.reason: This node describes the body-soul harmony: shamayim = neshamah, aretz = guf, and when there is shalom between them. Its essential nature is the body-soul peace that Package 3 is entirely about — containing nodes like גוף, נשמה, ארץ, רקיע, and דנשקי ארעא ורקיעא.
Inner peace (shalom ba'atzmav) is a variant phrasing of 'שלום בעצמיו' already in Package 3. Its essential nature is inner peace/body-soul harmony — the core concept of Package 3.

assignments.node_id: שלום־בית יהא שלום בעצמיו, בין גופו ונפשו
assignments.node_text: שְׁלוֹם־בַּיִת יְהֵא שָׁלוֹם בַּעֲצָמָיו, בֵּין גּוּפוֹ וְנַפְשׁוֹ
assignments.reason: Shalom bayit as inner peace between body and soul — this explicitly equates household peace with body-soul harmony. Both שלום בית and שלום בעצמיו are already in Package 3 (via Package 1 for שלום בית as bechina of אור, and Package 3 for שלום בעצמיו). This composite node's essential nature is the Shalom/body-soul domain.

This is a maqaf-variant of 'להחזיר בני אדם בתשובה' already in Package 1. Bringing people to teshuvah IS the definition of Kavod's elevation in this Torah (אם תוציא יקר מזולל). Same essential nature — Kavod's manifestation through outreach.

Tikkun habrit (rectification of the covenant/sexual purity) is the final disclosure of the Torah: bringing people to teshuvah IS tikkun keri — 'אתוון דדין כאתוון דדין'. The Rebbe places this as the hidden equivalence at the Torah's conclusion, binding the entire Kavod-elevation process to covenant-repair. In this Torah, tikkun habrit is defined through its identity with the Kavod-teshuvah process, placing it in Package 1.
